players.product: regulated electric service, gas generation and transmission build for hyperscale data centers in the Gulf South (Meta Richland Parish LA, Amazon Mississippi)

quarterly_data.signal: Entergy's second-quarter 2026 earnings release, Appendix C (Utility operating measures): industrial GWh sold were 17,164 in the second quarter of 2026 versus 15,620 in 2025, and 33,060 versus 29,452 year-to-date (12.3% change); total retail GWh sold (all retail classes: residential, commercial, governmental and industrial) were 33,725 versus 32,401 in the quarter and 64,461 versus 61,818 year-to-date. The industrial class is not data-center-only: the release attributes the second-quarter industrial volume increase to higher sales to data center, primary metals and chlor-alkali customers.

quarterly_data.signal: Entergy's second-quarter 2026 earnings release, Consolidated Cash Flow Statement (dollars in thousands, company-wide): construction/capital expenditures were 2,778,526 in the three months ended June 30, 2026 versus 2,008,157 in 2025, and 5,030,819 year to date June 30, 2026 versus 3,668,326 in 2025.
